purpose: Source-only two-stage current-member issuer classification before original financial-fact capture or return evaluation
hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 seed concatenated with zero-padded 10-digit positive CIK; ascending hexadecimal digest, then CIK
liquidity_measure: Median of same-row vendor quote.close * quote.volume on unique 2016 XNYS sessions; positive finite close, finite nonnegative volume, finite product. Zero-volume sessions count as observed zero activity. No adjclose, reconstructed nominal close, later return, or future split-event filter.
liquidity_vintage: Frozen September 2026 revised provider history; close-times-volume is a dollar-activity proxy, not actual historical traded dollars or calibrated execution cost
invalid_rows: Preserve every missing/invalid/noncalendar observation; any duplicate 2016 official session makes the source unusable. A missing source is retained, never replaced with new price acquisition.
listing: Frozen snapshot 20260918T201012673731Z-2da49ecfd9bb, USD asset_type stock, is_test=false, is_etf=false, next_shares=false
positive_title: Case-insensitive explicit common stock, common share or common shares in the saved exchange security title
negative_title: Whole-word ADR, ADS, depositary, depository, preferred, unit(s), warrant(s), right(s), fund(s), REIT, ETF, ETN, note(s), bond(s), or shares of beneficial interest; exact regex is frozen in cohort.py
mapping: Exact case-sensitive provider symbol equality to SEC company_tickers_exchange ticker; no punctuation conversion, name match, issuer-name inference or ticker-array-position inference. Ambiguous multi-CIK ticker mappings remain excluded.
share_class_deduplication: Apply title, mapping and 2016 liquidity gates first; within each CIK retain greatest qualifying 2016 median dollar activity, breaking ties by lexicographic symbol. Preserve every other class and its reason.
discovery_sequence: Freeze first 300 liquid unique CIKs in declared hash order. Obtain only their current SEC submissions profiles. No refill of this pool after classification failures.

current_profile_requirements.stateOfIncorporation: Exact two-letter code for one of the 50 US states or DC; foreign, missing or unresolved codes excluded. Never infer incorporation from mailing/business address or filing form.
current_profile_requirements.sic: Numeric SIC 0100-5999 or 7000-8999 inclusive; exclude missing/invalid, 0000, 6000-6999, 9000-9999

final_cohort: First 100 qualified profile records in the frozen pool hash order; if fewer qualify, retain the actual count and declare insufficient_qualified_issuers. Original financial extraction has not been used for admission; no replacements after final cohort freeze.
dated_classification: Preserve original filing-header SIC and cover evidence separately during later source capture. Current membership/incorporation/SIC is not a historical classification. Conflicts or missing historical evidence remain explicit per-event limitations, without changing the frozen cohort.
source_identity_policy: Freeze declaration/code/tests/listing/index/calendar/current ticker-map identities before offline pool generation; verify raw capture hashes, preserve raw paths and every requested/excluded symbol. Final cohort needs separately frozen current-profile sources.
limitations: Current surviving listings omit delisted issuers
Current incorporation and SIC may differ historically
Exact ticker matches do not establish historical entity continuity
Liquidity proxy does not guarantee affordable or profitable fills
US-incorporated does not mean exclusively US operations
